description: This file is a bootstrap script for the Notesnook project, managing dependencies, package installation, and build processes across multiple packages and environments.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes a shell command within a specified directory, capturing stdout and stderr.

methods.name: bootstrapPackage
methods.description: Runs npm install, rebuilds packages if needed, and executes post-install scripts for a given package directory.

methods.name: findDependencies
methods.description: Recursively finds all dependencies of a package, including nested dependencies, and builds a dependency map.

methods.name: filterDependencies
methods.description: Filters dependencies that are local file dependencies based on 'file:' prefix.

methods.name: needsRebuild
methods.description: Checks if packages in node_modules require rebuilding based on scripts present.

methods.name: hasScript
methods.description: Checks if a package.json in a directory contains a specific script.

methods.name: prompt
methods.description: Prompts the user for input via command line.

methods.name: analyzeDependencyMap
methods.description: Analyzes dependency versions across the monorepo and prompts for version resolution if conflicts exist.
